chapter_note: Chapter 37 is overwhelmingly cosmological substrate — a teaching about the Living Spirit hanging the Zones (cosmic spheres) one within another, mapping the five powers of Darkness within the five heaven-men/sons of the Man (=Primal Man's sons). Heavy manuscript damage (70.6%) but structural pattern is clear: zone-within-zone enumeration with the five powers of Darkness fettered within the five heaven-men. Only seg 2 carries dialogue frame attribution ("once again the Illuminator said") which must be stripped, preserving the substantive topic intro "concerning the Living Spirit." Title and chapter number are structural markers for the teaching unit.
